authentication: none; optional free NCBI API key
free_tier: free; 3 requests/second without a key, 10/second with a free key
historical_coverage: 37M+ citations; MEDLINE from 1966, OLDMEDLINE back to 1946
known_limitations: esummary returns no author affiliations, so PubMed alone cannot attribute a paper to a company
esummary returns no funder award ids; grant linking needs Europe PMC core or efetch
pubdate is often month-year only (coarse) and must not support lead-time claims
the NCBI books documentation page is behind a reCAPTCHA for automated clients; API behaviour was verified directly instead
licence: NLM terms of use; abstracts reusable with attribution, some records carry publisher copyright
rate_limits: 3 req/s without key, 10 req/s with key; tool= and email= parameters improve the politeness tier
research_value: The canonical biomedical citation index; useful mainly as the PMID authority and as a duplicate source to measure how much a naive collection over-counts the same paper.
